0.text: Every bet on Polymarket is public. Wallets get traced back to real people.

1.text: zPredict is a prediction market on Zcash that hides who bet.

2.text: No relayer, no chain observer and no counterparty learns who you are.

3.text: The markets mirror Polymarket. Prices stay public. Bettors stay hidden.

4.text: Deposit any amount from your own Zcash wallet. It is split into standard notes, so no amount stands out.

6.text: Pick a side, enter an amount in ZEC, and send.

7.text: Your browser splits the order into three random shares, one for each relayer.

8.text: The relayers match orders inside multi-party computation. Each one sees only noise.

9.text: The fill comes back the same way, as three shares.

10.text: Only your browser can put them back together.

11.text: Your portfolio and profit and loss are computed only in your browser. The relayers never see them.

12.text: Outcomes are signed by two of three relayers, and your browser checks the signature.

13.text: Here is exactly who learns what, including today's limit: one server runs all three relayers.

14.text: And it works end to end on Zcash testnet: deposit, fill, signed outcome, and payout.
